provenance: Synthetic application requests captured as exact HTTP bodies from the actual SDK on a mock transport. No provider was contacted; reply usage zeros are mock data and are not retained as measurements.
note: Expected boundaries test the documented message invalidation plus an explicitly conservative all-level scope; these are not observed provider cache results.

findings.title: Thinking or effort cache settings changed
findings.detail: thinking configuration differs between requests 1 and 2. Anthropic documents that these changes invalidate message entries even when visible text is identical. Tool and system survival is model-specific: this simulation conservatively isolates all three cache levels rather than inferring the provider's hidden prompt placement. Actual setup reuse and costs may differ. An earlier request with the current settings can still supply a hit. Both scenarios keep these settings; documented mode and effort defaults are normalized only for recognized recorded models.
